lines.text: [VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: You did it, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\nOh man, that’s great... I’ve been waiting!
I beat the Elite Four and became the Champion!
You probably heard from the professor, right?\c\nFrom now on, the Champion will be part of the\nPokémon League and battle all kinds of Trainers!
I’m really glad my first opponent turned out to\nbe you, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!
You’re the one Trainer I want to test my best\nagainst, after all!
Let’s battle, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\nThe Champion’s seat is on the line!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: I’ve been waiting for you...\nChampion!
I’ve been training every day to try to\nbeat you, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\c\nAnd I’m not gonna lose today! Let’s battle!
